summary: End-to-end tested Stock Checking Module (Cek Stok). Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass covering auth, RBAC (403 on admin endpoints for employee, 403 on /my-tasks for admin), blind count (no stok_sistem/stok_minimum leaked), employee check submission, Master Barang CRUD, Barang Masuk auto-updates master rack+stock (mandatory rack via 422 validation), Penugasan assign/list/delete, user create/reset-password/delete, Summary shape + employee filter, logout clears cookies. Frontend: admin lands on /admin/dashboard, employee on /employee/my-tasks with title 'Stock Check – Budi Santoso' (en dash), Rangkuman nav visible only for admin, all 5 SummaryPage tabs (tab-breakdown, tab-unchecked, tab-out-of-stock, tab-low-stock, tab-discrepancy-items) render, blind-count dialog exposes employee-physical-stock-input-{kode} and submit-check-btn and does NOT contain 'Stok Sistem', RBAC redirect: /admin/summary as employee redirects to /employee/my-tasks, /admin/master-barang has btn-add-master-barang, BarangMasukPage has inbound-rack-location-input + inbound-submit-btn, /admin/karyawan lists all 4 users with reset/delete actions, logout returns to /login.

issues: React console warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (LoginPage)' — likely a setState during render inside a redirect. Not blocking, but should be wrapped in useEffect or replaced with <Navigate/> to avoid noisy warnings.

action_items: (Optional) Fix LoginPage React warning: replace in-render navigate() with <Navigate/> or wrap in useEffect.
critical_code_review_comments: Login attempts lockout uses ip+username identifier; brute-force reset happens only on successful login. Good, but consider clearing lockout on password reset (as playbook suggests).
seed() is idempotent for admin (updates password if changed) — good. Demo barang/tugas only seeded when barang collection empty — good.

CORS allow_origins reads from FRONTEND_URL env only; ensure production sets it — otherwise falls back to http://localhost:3000 which would block preview URL. Current preview works because FRONTEND_URL is set.
server.py is 633 lines; consider splitting routers (auth/barang/penugasan/summary) into separate modules if it grows further.
No forgot-password endpoint implemented (not in scope per problem statement; admin resets via /api/users).
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded demo data (15 barang, 3 employees, 15 tugas). Created and cleaned up ephemeral TEST_ items and users during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend admin routes are /admin/master-barang and /admin/karyawan (not /admin/master or /admin/users). Employee route is /employee/my-tasks. Login inputs have no name attr; select by index or placeholder 'mis. admin'. Title uses en dash '–' between 'Stock Check' and employee name.
rca of the issue: No critical bugs found. Only a benign React warning on LoginPage caused by triggering navigation during render.
